main_body: Wooden open-top box (rows 10-14) with a dark coal heap piled above its rim (rows 3-9).
top_band: none. Column x=8 runs from the near-black coal (L=19, rows 3-9) straight to a 1-row light brown rim (#8a6038, row 10), then the front face. No multi-row lighter top surface exists.
evidence: The box is a flat front view. Its top is only a 1-row rim (row 10), and the 4-row front face below it (rows 11-14) is a flat brown with no recessed detail. The coal heap is a near-uniform dark silhouette (L about 19) with no readable top surface seen from above, so the bin's interior is not shown as an opening. The side walls are thin vertical strips. This matches the guide's red 'rim only' and 'front elevation' cases.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours against 38-40 for the references, and a median of 8 colours per tile against 17-20. The coal mass is nearly one flat near-black with a few bluish-grey specks, and the wood has only about 3-4 tones with little grain. The dark edge pixels are partly neutral (29%), so the outline is mixed. It reads as much shallower and flatter than the cheese stall and the roofed well.
